_doc: ODI AURA Blueprint v1.1 Lampiran C. status: met | partial | unproven | not_met | not_applicable_yet. Dasar: AURA A0 16 Nov 2026 (docs/odi/AURA_A0_AUDIT.md). Diubah hanya oleh bukti uji.

tests.title: NEXUS-only: rencana berkeyakinan rendah/mahal/antre/lambat tidak memicu fallback AI luar
tests.evidence: nexus.TestAT01_HealthyNexusNeverTriggersExternalAI: low confidence, insufficient evidence, overload, rate limit, deadline, bad request and a slow call never reach an external provider and never make NEXUS look unavailable (fake NEXUS). Default mode is off until the owner switches; no real NEXUS exists yet

tests.title: Fallback ditolak bila policy AURA menolak atau tidak tersedia
tests.evidence: nexus.TestAT02_FallbackNeedsEvidenceAndAURAPolicy: with valid unavailability evidence, no provider named / data class not permitted / policy unreadable / health unknown / merely degraded all deny; an authorization is scoped (providers, budget, call count, expiry), evidence-referenced and audited; an exhausted one is not renewed (fake NEXUS)

tests.title: Pemulihan NEXUS menghentikan grant fallback baru dan mencabut grant berjalan
tests.evidence: nexus.TestAT03_RecoveryRevokesFallbackAndReturnsToNexus: recovery (consecutive probes + hold-down) revokes every authorization (audited), a revoked one cannot be used, new calls go to NEXUS; TestOwnerDisableAllowsScopedFallbackWithoutCallingNexus; TestMonitorHysteresis (fake NEXUS)

tests.title: Ubah satu parameter material membatalkan persetujuan; replay dan kedaluwarsa ditolak
tests.evidence: policy.TestApprovalIntegrity (hash mismatch, changed parameter invalidates, reuse refused, expiry refused) + TestNewRequestInvalidatesPrevious; API 409 approval_mismatch / 410 approval_expired

tests.title: Pekerja tidak bisa membaca DB Core, rahasia, kredensial host, atau jaringan sembarang
tests.evidence: live probe 2026-11-16 (deploy/checks/worker-isolation.sh, kept in docs/odi/evidence): as uid 10002 the DB, API token, provider key and workspaces are unreadable, no TCP/UDP/DNS, only lo exists, writes outside scratch denied; container network none, read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL; engine.TestOutOfScopeRequestsDeniedAndAudited (hostile worker). Re-run after every deploy

tests.title: Pengiriman ganda API/peristiwa tidak menggandakan efek samping
tests.evidence: API Idempotency-Key (engine TestCreateValidationIdempotencyAndErrors), webhook dedup (app TestSignedWebhookRaisesEventOnce), step idempotency keys, trigger once per slot (TestTriggerCreatesTaskOncePerSlot), app.TestCrashRecovery (20 random SIGKILLs, no duplicate effect)

tests.title: Konten situs/alat berbahaya tidak bisa menambah kapabilitas atau mengubah kebijakan
tests.evidence: engine.TestDynamicFetchWithoutProvenanceDenied (a URL that only appears in an injected snippet is denied), TestOutOfScopeRequestsDeniedAndAudited (hostile worker: out-of-plan, out-of-scope, forged-token and escaping calls all denied and audited), TestA3ForbiddenWrite, TestDelegationGrantWideningDenied; page text/tool output is data, authority comes only from Core-issued grants and tiers

tests.title: Pencabutan owner/perangkat/tugas menghentikan aksi berikutnya dan mengisolasi pekerja
tests.evidence: grant revocation proven (policy.TestGrantVerification), cancel/kill stop workers (TestCancelKillsWorkerQuickly, TestKillSwitch, TestCancelRootCancelsDescendants, TestDisconnectKillsBusyWorker); owner/device revocation needs the device registry (A6)

tests.title: Respons alat tanpa postcondition terverifikasi tidak dilaporkan selesai
tests.evidence: odi.TestDeriveTruthfulClaims (a V1/V0 result is never completed_verified), TestWeakestEffectDrivesTheReplyNote + reply note unverified_outcome; ADR-0071

tests.title: Restart Core dan pekerja mati dilanjutkan/direkonsiliasi dari checkpoint tanpa replay tidak aman
tests.evidence: app.TestCrashRecovery: 20 random SIGKILLs of Core+worker, interrupted tasks resume and complete; TestDisconnectKillsBusyWorker; step recovery events (TASK_RECOVERED/STEP_RECOVERED)

tests.title: Takeover desktop menjeda otomasi; handback butuh observasi baru dan rekonsiliasi
tests.evidence: belum ada pekerja desktop (takeover browser P5a ada)

tests.title: Cadangan pulih ke keadaan teruji dengan RPO/RTO terdokumentasi dan pemeriksaan integritas
tests.evidence: integrity_check salinan SQLite ok (16 Nov); pemulihan penuh ke kontainer AURA belum; RPO/RTO belum ditetapkan
